name: Mondelez Toledo Flour Mill - Toledo OH

fieldNotes.location: Positively resolved to 2221 Front St, Toledo OH 43605 — the historic Toledo Flour Mill on the east bank of the Maumee River in the Birmingham/Ironville industrial district of East Toledo. Street View (Aug 2023) shows the riverside grain-elevator silo cluster branded 'Mondelez'. Roster city-centroid (41.6528,-83.5379) was ~2km SW in a downtown riverfront park; corrected via Nominatim geocode of the street address plus satellite + Street View confirmation. NOTE: Mennel Milling acquired this mill from Mondelez in November 2025 — under Mondelez ownership for the campaign period, now Mennel-operated.
fieldNotes.facilityType: Bulk soft-wheat flour mill, not a packaged-goods DC. ~61,000 sq ft six-story mill plus extensive grain-elevator silos; 4.9-5.5M bushel storage. Truck activity is bulk flour loadout and bulk wheat receiving via silo spouts, plus heavy rail; there is no conventional packaged-goods dock-door bank.
fieldNotes.truckGate: TRUE — the property is enclosed by chain-link fencing along Front Street (visible in Street View); the truck driveway off Front St passes through a fenced entry. A controlled fenced industrial entrance.
fieldNotes.guardShack: FALSE — no staffed guard booth visible at the Front St entrance in 2022/2023 Street View or in satellite. The low brick building at the frontage is the mill office, not a gate booth.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: TRUE — there is a controlled/fenced truck gate but no guard shack, implying self / kiosk check-in at the mill office.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: 0-10 — bulk flour loadout points, not a packaged-goods dock bank; only a handful of truck loadout positions. Low confidence on exact count.
fieldNotes.dropArea: NONE — no marked drop-trailer parking; this is a bulk mill, trucks load and leave.
fieldNotes.scale: TRUE (medium confidence) — a truck scale is standard at a grain/flour mill for inbound wheat and outbound flour weighing; a small scale-house structure is consistent with the imagery near the entrance, though not unambiguously resolved.
fieldNotes.railServed: TRUE — extensive rail yard with many curving spurs woven through the entire property serving the grain elevators; a railroad-crossing marking is painted on Front St. River barge dock also present.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: TRUE — the site is a campus of multiple distinct structures: the milling building, separate grain-elevator silo banks, warehouse/loadout buildings, and the office.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Urban — dense East Toledo industrial/residential fabric on the Maumee riverfront.
